walkthrough: After each quarter the Access Governance Lead exports every Entra user with their groups and roles. Each manager reviews their team and marks each line keep or remove, IT removes what was marked and the lead signs off. The review is due 15 days after quarter end.
design_test: Assessed whether the procedure prevents self-review and checks the review list against HR terminations.
design_result: The procedure lets managers and admins review their own access, and the review list is not reconciled against the HR leaver list before it goes out.
toe_test: Reconciled the Q3 review sign-off (evidence/access_review_q3.csv) against entra_users.csv and hr_leavers.csv.
exceptions: Signed off on 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-21, 5 to 6 days after the 2026-10-15 due date. dmoreau and labadmin approved their own access. rpatel was marked keep 21 days after their last day.

walkthrough: analyze.py pulls every permission set assignment from the Salesforce lab org, checks each user against six AP SoD rules and lists each conflict with the permission set it came from. Each conflict is either removed or accepted with a documented reason in remediation-plan.csv.
design_test: Assessed whether the rules cover the AP duties that must be split (vendor setup, bank details, invoice entry, payment approval, user admin) and whether every conflict needs a decision.
design_result: The six rules cover the high risk duty pairs, and every exception has to be removed or accepted with a documented reason.
toe_test: Inspected the October first run, the remediation plan and the rerun after remediation (access-governance-lab/reports).
exceptions: None. 6 conflicts were removed by revoking permission sets. The 4 left are Medium, on the two admin accounts, and accepted with field history and the setup audit trail as compensating controls.

walkthrough: HR raises a leaver ticket with the person's last day. The IT Service Desk disables the Entra account on that day and closes the ticket.
design_test: Assessed whether the ticket process would block a former employee from signing in.
design_result: Disabling the account on the last day blocks sign-in, and the HR ticket triggers the process.
toe_test: Reconciled every leaver in hr_leavers.csv against account status in entra_users.csv.
exceptions: rpatel left on 2026-09-30 and was still enabled on 2026-11-17, 48 days later. Ticket HR-1057 was never actioned.

walkthrough: Admin roles are limited to named admin accounts and every admin must register MFA. The Identity Team reviews role assignments monthly and removes standing roles that aren't needed.
design_test: Assessed whether named admins with MFA and a monthly role review address account takeover and privilege creep.
design_result: Named admin accounts with MFA and a monthly role review would address the risk.
toe_test: Listed every directory role assignment (entra_roles.csv) and checked each holder's owner, job and authentication methods in the Entra portal.
exceptions: tempadmin held standing Global Administrator with no owner and no MFA method registered. jwalsh (IT Support Analyst) still held User Administrator from a migration, which the job doesn't need.

walkthrough: cve-triage prioritises scan findings and jira_tickets.py opens a ticket for every P1 and P2 with an SLA due date (7 days for P1, 30 for P2). The owner remediates and a rescan confirms the fix.
design_test: Assessed whether the process makes sure every P1 is tracked to a due date and fixed within 7 days.
design_result: Tickets from the current script always get a due date, but nothing stops a ticket being created without one and there is no report of overdue tickets.
toe_test: Pulled every P1 ticket in the VULN project (evidence/jira_vuln_tickets.csv) and compared created, due and resolved dates as of 2026-11-17.
exceptions: VULN-4 was open 19 days past its 2026-10-29 due date. VULN-3 was open after 26 days with no due date. VULN-1 and VULN-2 were resolved in 2 days but had no due date.

walkthrough: assets.csv records every system with an owner, criticality and whether it is internet facing. Every system on it is scanned and new systems are added before go-live.
design_test: Assessed whether the inventory has the fields needed to route and prioritise findings.
design_result: Owner, criticality and exposure are all recorded, which is what the triage needs.
toe_test: Reconciled assets.csv against the hosts in the latest scans (reports/scan2.csv and reports/kali.csv).
exceptions: None. Both systems were scanned and their findings carry the owner from the inventory.

walkthrough: Changes are made on a branch, opened as a pull request and approved by another engineer before they merge to main.
design_test: Checked the repository settings to see if a change can reach main without an approval.
design_result: None of the four repositories has branch protection, so anyone with write access can push straight to main. Review is not enforced.
toe_test: Sampled 10 commits on main per repository (seed 2026, collect_evidence.py) and traced each one to a pull request and its approvals (evidence/change_samples.csv).
exceptions: 0 of 40 sampled commits came through a pull request. The one pull request in the period (cve-triage #1) was merged without an approval.

walkthrough: Secret scanning and push protection are on for every repository, so a push containing a known key format is blocked.
design_test: Assessed whether the setting stops a credential before it reaches the repository history.
design_result: Push protection rejects the push before the secret is in the history.
toe_test: Pulled the security settings for all four repositories (evidence/repo_settings.csv).
exceptions: None. Secret scanning and push protection are on for all four.

walkthrough: Every push and pull request runs the unit tests, pip-audit and bandit in GitHub Actions, and the checks also run weekly. Dependabot flags vulnerable dependencies.
design_test: Assessed whether every repository with code runs the checks.
design_result: Only cve-triage has a workflow. The other three repositories have none, and Dependabot security updates are off on all four.
toe_test: Inspected the workflow list and Dependabot setting for each repository and the last 8 runs for cve-triage.
exceptions: All 8 recent cve-triage runs passed. access-governance-lab, splunk-detections and traffic-analysis have no checks.

walkthrough: Splunk searches look for SSH brute force, a success after repeated failures, off-hours logins and web scanning. An analyst triages the alerts daily.
design_test: Assessed whether the searches cover the main attacks on the lab VM and whether the review is recorded.
design_result: The four searches cover the expected attacks, but the procedure has no step for recording who reviewed an alert or what was decided.
toe_test: Read the four searches and the dashboard in splunk-detections and requested the review records for the period.
exceptions: No review records exist, so operating effectiveness could not be tested.
